name: poly-clear-on-rest
description: Clears a step's chord record when the firmware commits a rest/clear (commit FUN_0801F32C is called with r1 < 0). Hook at 0x0801F32E (reproduces strb.w r1,[r0,#0x2f5]) checks r1; if negative it zeroes poly[track][step] at 0x1000B530 + track*0x880 + step*17. Normal note commits (r1 >= 0) leave the chord intact, so adding a note does not wipe the step.

patches.note: rest/clear commit also clears the step's poly record
